name: Example: Kinetic Blast Deadeye (Mirage-league meta tree)
notes: Modeled on a popular poe.ninja Mirage-league Kinetic Blast Deadeye wander (level 100, ~4k life + ES), validated against this deployment’s tree (3.28.0k Mirage). The evasion archetype: projectile/wand damage on the dex side with % life (~68% increased on this tree — ranged evasion builds run 50-100% and compensate with evasion, spell suppression and Ghost Dance-style recovery). Resistances come from gear, not the tree.
